dedupe_keys.name: stay grounded map of planned airport expansion projects

description: Stay Grounded, a network campaigning for a reduction of aviation, publishes a world map of planned airport infrastructure projects. The page counts 423 new airports planned or under construction, 223 of them in the Asia-Pacific region and 58 in Europe, together with 121 additional runways (28 in Europe), 205 runway extensions, 262 new terminals and 175 terminal extensions, more than 1,200 projects in total. The page states that the numbers are from 2017 and come from the CAPA airport construction database, a commercial source. Coverage: global. Format and access: an interactive web map without registration. Licence and cost: free to view; no reuse licence is stated, and the underlying CAPA data are proprietary. Caveats: the figures are a 2017 snapshot compiled by an advocacy network, project status will have changed since, and no downloadable table is offered. It supports capacity planning and climate scenario work that needs a list of expected airport capacity additions. It relates to the ACI World airport traffic data and the OurAirports records in the catalogue, which describe existing airports.
